const nextConfig = {
  reactStrictMode: true,
  poweredByHeader: false,

  /* Performance */
  compress: true,
  productionBrowserSourceMaps: false,
  compiler: {
    removeConsole:
      process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
        ? { exclude: ['error', 'warn'] }
        : false,
  },

  /* Image optimization */
  images: {
    formats: ['image/avif', 'image/webp'],
    deviceSizes: [360, 480, 640, 750, 828, 1080, 1200, 1920],
    imageSizes: [16, 32, 48, 64, 96, 128, 256, 384],
    minimumCacheTTL: 60 * 60 * 24 * 30,
    dangerouslyAllowSVG: false,
  },

  /* Modules & packages */
  experimental: {
    optimizePackageImports: [
      'shiki',
      '@vercel/analytics',
      '@vercel/speed-insights',
    ],
  },

  /* HTTP Headers: Cache + Security */
  async headers() {
    return [
      /* 1) Static public assets */
      {
        source:
          '/(.*)\\.(woff2|woff|ttf|otf|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg|webp|avif|ico|mp4|webm)',
        headers: [
          {
            key: 'Cache-Control',
            value: 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable',
          },
        ],
      },

      /* 2) HTML pages */
      {
        source: '/((?!api|_next|_vercel|.*\\..*).*)',
        headers: [
          {
            key: 'Cache-Control',
            value:
              'public, max-age=120, s-maxage=86400, stale-while-revalidate=604800',
          },
        ],
      },

      /* 3) Blog posts - longer cache */
      {
        source: '/blog/:path*',
        headers: [
          {
            key: 'Cache-Control',
            value:
              'public, max-age=300, s-maxage=604800, stale-while-revalidate=2592000',
          },
        ],
      },

      /* 4) Security headers */
      {
        source: '/(.*)',
        headers: [
          { key: 'X-Content-Type-Options', value: 'nosniff' },
          {
            key: 'Referrer-Policy',
            value: 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin',
          },
          { key: 'X-Frame-Options', value: 'SAMEORIGIN' },
          { key: 'X-DNS-Prefetch-Control', value: 'on' },
          {
            key: 'Permissions-Policy',
            value: 'camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()',
          },
          {
            key: 'Strict-Transport-Security',
            value: 'max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload',
          },
          {
            key: 'Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy',
            value: 'same-origin',
          },
        ],
      },
    ];
  },

  /* 301 Redirects */
  async redirects() {
    return [
      /* 1) Specific: www -> canonical */
      {
        source: '/:path*',
        has: [{ type: 'host', value: 'www.shorakaei.ir' }],
        destination: 'https://shorakaei.ir/:path*',

const themeInitScript = `
(function () {
  try {
    var stored = localStorage.getItem('theme');
    var theme;
    if (stored === 'light' || stored === 'dark') {
      theme = stored;
    } else if (
      window.matchMedia &&
      window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
    ) {
      theme = 'dark';
    } else {
      theme = 'light';
    }
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
  } catch (e) {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');
  }
})();
`;

import dynamic from "next/dynamic";
import Nav from "@/components/Nav";
import MobileNav from "@/components/MobileNav";
import Hero from "@/components/Hero";
import { getAllPosts, getLatestPosts } from "@/lib/blog";
import { projects } from "@/content/projects";

/* ── Above-the-fold: direct import (need immediate render) ── */
/* Nav, MobileNav, Hero */

/* ── Below-the-fold: dynamic imports with SSR preserved ── */
/* ssr: true means server renders them into HTML for SEO,
   but client-side JS chunk loads separately = smaller initial bundle */

const Services = dynamic(() => import("@/components/Services"), {
  ssr: true,
  loading: () => (
    <section className="section" aria-busy="true">
      <div className="container">
        <div className="lazy-skeleton-grid" aria-hidden="true">
          <div className="lazy-skeleton-card" />
          <div className="lazy-skeleton-card" />
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  ),
});

const Process = dynamic(() => import("@/components/Process"), { ssr: true });

const Portfolio = dynamic(() => import("@/components/Portfolio"), {
  ssr: true,
  loading: () => (
    <section
      className="section portfolio-section"
      aria-busy="true"
      aria-label="در حال بارگذاری نمونه‌کارها"
    >
      <div className="container">
        <div className="lazy-skeleton-grid" aria-hidden="true">
          <div className="lazy-skeleton-card" />
          <div className="lazy-skeleton-card" />
          <div className="lazy-skeleton-card" />
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  ),
});

const About = dynamic(() => import("@/components/About"), { ssr: true });

const WhyMe = dynamic(() => import("@/components/WhyMe"), { ssr: true });

const Testimonials = dynamic(() => import("@/components/Testimonials"), {
  ssr: true,
});

const LatestBlogPosts = dynamic(
  () => import("@/components/LatestBlogPosts"),
  { ssr: true }
);

const Newsletter = dynamic(() => import("@/components/Newsletter"), {
  ssr: true,
});

const FAQ = dynamic(() => import("@/components/FAQ"), { ssr: true });

const FinalCTA = dynamic(() => import("@/components/FinalCTA"), { ssr: true });

const Footer = dynamic(() => import("@/components/Footer"), { ssr: true });

const BackToTop = dynamic(() => import("@/components/BackToTop"), { ssr: true });

const RevealObserver = dynamic(() => import("@/components/RevealObserver"), {
  ssr: true,
});

const SectionSwipeHandler = dynamic(
  () => import("@/components/SectionSwipeHandler"),
  { ssr: true }
);

const SwipeHint = dynamic(() => import("@/components/SwipeHint"), {
  ssr: true,
});

const PerfObserver = dynamic(() => import("@/components/PerfObserver"), {
  ssr: true,
});

export default function Home() {
  const allPosts = getAllPosts();
  const recentPosts = getLatestPosts(6);

  const latestPost = recentPosts[0]
    ? {
        slug: recentPosts[0].slug,
        title: recentPosts[0].title,
        date: recentPosts[0].date,
      }
    : null;

  const archiveSource =
    recentPosts.length > 4
      ? recentPosts[4]
      : recentPosts[recentPosts.length - 1];
  const archivePost =
    archiveSource && archiveSource.slug !== latestPost?.slug
      ? {
          slug: archiveSource.slug,
          title: archiveSource.title,
          date: archiveSource.date,
        }
      : null;

  return (
    <>
      <Nav />
      <MobileNav />

      <main id="main">
        <Hero
          latestPost={latestPost}
          archivePost={archivePost}
          totalPosts={allPosts.length}
          totalProjects={projects.length}
        />
        <Services />
        <Process />
        <Portfolio />
        <About />
        <WhyMe />
        <Testimonials />
        <LatestBlogPosts />
        <Newsletter />
        <FAQ />
        <FinalCTA />
      </main>

      <Footer />
      <BackToTop />
      <RevealObserver />
      <SectionSwipeHandler />
      <SwipeHint />
      <PerfObserver />
    </>
  );
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   COMPONENT
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export default function Nav() {
  const { theme, toggleTheme } = useTheme();
  const pathname = usePathname();

  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);
  const [activeSection, setActiveSection] = useState("home");
  const [hoveredIndex, setHoveredIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const ticking = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => {
      const y = window.scrollY;
      setScrolled(y > 20);
    };

    const onScroll = () => {
      if (ticking.current) return;
      ticking.current = true;
      window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        handleScroll();
        ticking.current = false;
      });
    };

    handleScroll();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleScroll);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", handleScroll);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return;
    if (pathname !== "/") return;

    const sections = navItems
      .filter((item) => item.section)
      .map((item) => document.getElementById(item.section!))
      .filter((el): el is HTMLElement => el !== null);

    if (!sections.length) return;

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        const visible = entries
          .filter((entry) => entry.isIntersecting)
          .sort((a, b) => b.intersectionRatio - a.intersectionRatio)[0];
        if (visible?.target instanceof Element && visible.target.id) {
          setActiveSection(visible.target.id);
        }
      },
      { rootMargin: "-25% 0px -55% 0px", threshold: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] }
    );

    sections.forEach((section) => observer.observe(section));
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [pathname]);

  const isBlogPage = pathname?.startsWith("/blog") ?? false;

  let activeIndex = 0;
  if (isBlogPage) {
    activeIndex = navItems.findIndex((item) => item.icon === "blog");
  } else if (pathname === "/") {
    const found = navItems.findIndex((item) => item.section === activeSection);
    if (found >= 0) activeIndex = found;
  }

  const previewItem = hoveredIndex !== null ? navItems[hoveredIndex] : null;
  const totalCount = navItems.length;

  return (
    <header className={"site-nav" + (scrolled ? " is-scrolled" : "")}>
      <div className="container">
        <div className="nav-inner">
          <div className="nav-pill">
            <a href="/#home" className="brand" aria-label="بازگشت به بالای صفحه">
              <span className="brand-mark-wrap">
                <Image src="/logo.png" alt="" width={72} height={72}
                  className="brand-mark brand-logo" aria-hidden="true" priority />
              </span>
              <span className="brand-text">
                <strong>امیرحسین شرکائی</strong>
                <small>Amirhossein Shorakaei</small>
              </span>
            </a>

            <nav
              className="desktop-nav"
              aria-label="منوی اصلی سایت"
              style={
                {
                  "--nav-index": activeIndex,
                  "--nav-total": totalCount,
                } as React.CSSProperties
              }
            >
              <div className="desktop-nav-list">
                <span className="desktop-nav-slider" aria-hidden="true">
                  <span className="desktop-nav-slider-pulse" />
                </span>
                {navItems.map((item, i) => {
                  const isHash = item.href.startsWith("#");
                  const isBlogLink = item.href === "/blog";
                  const sectionId = item.section ?? "";
                  const isActive = isBlogLink
                    ? isBlogPage
                    : isHash && pathname === "/" && activeSection === sectionId;

                  const content = (
                    <>
                      <span className="desktop-nav-icon" aria-hidden="true">
                        <NavIcon type={item.icon} />
                      </span>
                      <span className="desktop-nav-text">{item.label}</span>
                    </>
                  );

                  const commonProps = {
                    className:
                      "desktop-nav-item" + (isActive ? " is-active" : ""),
                    onMouseEnter: () => setHoveredIndex(i),
                    onMouseLeave: () => setHoveredIndex(null),
                    onFocus: () => setHoveredIndex(i),
                    onBlur: () => setHoveredIndex(null),
                    style: { "--nav-i": i } as React.CSSProperties,
                  };

                  if (isHash) {
                    return (
                      <a
                        key={item.href}
                        href={pathname === "/" ? item.href : `/${item.href}`}
                        aria-current={isActive ? "true" : undefined}
                        {...commonProps}
                      >
                        {content}
                      </a>
                    );
                  }
                  return (
                    <Link
                      key={item.href}
                      href={item.href}
                      aria-current={isActive ? "page" : undefined}
                      {...commonProps}
                    >
                      {content}
                    </Link>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {previewItem && <PreviewCard item={previewItem} />}
            </nav>

            <div className="nav-actions">
              <MagneticButton strength={0.15} radius={50}>
                <Link href="/order" prefetch={false} className="nav-order-button">
                  <span className="nav-order-shine" aria-hidden="true" />
                  <span>شروع پروژه</span>
                  <span className="nav-order-arrow" aria-hidden="true">←</span>
                </Link>
              </MagneticButton>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="theme-toggle"
                aria-label={theme === "dark" ? "حالت روشن" : "حالت تاریک"}
                aria-pressed={theme === "dark"}
                onClick={toggleTheme}
              >
                <span className="theme-toggle-inner" aria-hidden="true">
                  <svg className="theme-icon theme-icon-sun" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"
                    stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round">
                    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4" />
                    <path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M4.93 4.93l1.41 1.41M17.66 17.66l1.41 1.41M2 12h2M20 12h2M4.93 19.07l1.41-1.41M17.66 6.34l1.41-1.41" />
                  </svg>
                  <svg className="theme-icon theme-icon-moon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"
                    stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                    <path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z" />
                  </svg>
                </span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SOUND — subtle haptic tick tone
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
let audioCtx: AudioContext | null = null;

function playTick() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  try {
    if (!audioCtx) {
      const Ctx =
        window.AudioContext ||
        (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
      audioCtx = new Ctx();
    }
    if (audioCtx.state === "suspended") audioCtx.resume();
    const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
    const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
    osc.type = "sine";
    osc.frequency.value = 680;
    const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now);
    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + 0.003);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.04);
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    osc.start(now);
    osc.stop(now + 0.05);
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
}

export default function MobileNav() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [activeSection, setActiveSection] = useState("home");
  const [scrollProgress, setScrollProgress] = useState(0);
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const [scrubIndex, setScrubIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const itemsRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const lastTickIndex = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const dragRaf = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => { setMounted(true); }, []);

  /* Track active section */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (pathname !== "/") return;
    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return;

    const ids = NAV_ITEMS.map((i) => i.section).filter((s) => s !== "blog");
    const els = ids
      .map((id) => document.getElementById(id))
      .filter((el): el is HTMLElement => el !== null);

    if (!els.length) return;

    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        const visible = entries
          .filter((e) => e.isIntersecting)
          .sort((a, b) => b.intersectionRatio - a.intersectionRatio)[0];
        if (visible?.target.id) setActiveSection(visible.target.id);
      },
      { rootMargin: "-30% 0px -55% 0px", threshold: [0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1] }
    );
    els.forEach((el) => io.observe(el));
    return () => io.disconnect();
  }, [mounted, pathname]);

  /* Scroll progress for logo ring */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mounted) return;
    let ticking = false;
    const onScroll = () => {
      if (ticking) return;
      ticking = true;
      window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        const y = window.scrollY;
        const docH = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
        setScrollProgress(docH > 0 ? Math.min(1, Math.max(0, y / docH)) : 0);
        ticking = false;
      });
    };
    onScroll();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll);
  }, [mounted]);

  /* ─── Finger Scrubbing ─── */
  const haptic = useCallback((pattern: number[]) => {
    if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && "vibrate" in navigator) {
      try { navigator.vibrate(pattern); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    }
  }, []);

  const handleScrubStart = useCallback((e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    if (!itemsRef.current) return;
    setIsDragging(true);
    lastTickIndex.current = null;
    haptic([0, 8]);
  }, [haptic]);

  const handleScrubMove = useCallback((e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    if (!isDragging || !itemsRef.current) return;
    const touch = e.touches[0];
    const rect = itemsRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const relativeX = touch.clientX - rect.left;
    const itemWidth = rect.width / NAV_ITEMS.length;
    const index = Math.max(0, Math.min(NAV_ITEMS.length - 1, Math.floor(relativeX / itemWidth)));

    if (dragRaf.current) cancelAnimationFrame(dragRaf.current);
    dragRaf.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      setScrubIndex(index);
      if (lastTickIndex.current !== index) {
        lastTickIndex.current = index;
        haptic([0, 10]);
        playTick();
      }
    });
  }, [isDragging, haptic]);

  const handleScrubEnd = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    setIsDragging(false);
    if (dragRaf.current) cancelAnimationFrame(dragRaf.current);

    if (scrubIndex !== null) {
      const target = NAV_ITEMS[scrubIndex];
      haptic([0, 6, 20, 6]);
      if (target.href.startsWith("#")) {
        const el = document.getElementById(target.section);
        if (el) {
          const top = el.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 80;
          window.scrollTo({ top, behavior: "smooth" });
        }
      } else {
        window.location.href = target.href;
      }
    }
    setScrubIndex(null);
    lastTickIndex.current = null;
  }, [isDragging, scrubIndex, haptic]);

  if (!mounted) return null;

  const isOnHome = pathname === "/";
  const isBlogPage = pathname?.startsWith("/blog") ?? false;

  let activeIndex = -1;
  if (isBlogPage) {
    activeIndex = NAV_ITEMS.findIndex((item) => item.section === "blog");
  } else if (isOnHome) {
    activeIndex = NAV_ITEMS.findIndex((item) => item.section === activeSection);
  }

  const indicatorIndex = scrubIndex !== null ? scrubIndex : activeIndex >= 0 ? activeIndex : 0;
  const hideIndicator = activeIndex < 0 && scrubIndex === null;
  const isOrderPage = pathname?.startsWith("/order") ?? false;

  const activeAuraColor = NAV_ITEMS[indicatorIndex]?.auraColor ?? "rgba(233, 75, 44, 0.55)";
  const RING_R = 14;
  const RING_C = 2 * Math.PI * RING_R;

  return (
    <nav
      className="mbn"
      aria-label="ناوبری موبایل"
      data-hide-indicator={hideIndicator ? "true" : "false"}
      data-dragging={isDragging ? "true" : "false"}
      style={{
        "--mbn-index": indicatorIndex,
        "--mbn-aura": activeAuraColor,
        "--mbn-count": NAV_ITEMS.length,
      } as React.CSSProperties}
    >
      {/* Aurora glow */}
      <span className="mbn-aurora" aria-hidden="true">
        <span className="mbn-aurora-glow" />
      </span>

      {/* Items container with scrub handlers */}
      <div
        ref={itemsRef}
        className="mbn-items"
        onTouchStart={handleScrubStart}
        onTouchMove={handleScrubMove}
        onTouchEnd={handleScrubEnd}
        onTouchCancel={handleScrubEnd}
      >
        <span className="mbn-slider" aria-hidden="true">
          <span className="mbn-slider-glow" />
        </span>

        {NAV_ITEMS.map((item, i) => {
          const isActive = i === indicatorIndex && !hideIndicator;
          const isHome = item.type === "logo";
          const isScrubbing = scrubIndex === i;

          return (
            <Link
              key={item.id}
              href={item.href}
              className={
                "mbn-item" +
                (isActive ? " is-active" : "") +
                (isScrubbing ? " is-scrubbing" : "")
              }
              aria-current={isActive ? "page" : undefined}
              aria-label={item.label}
            >
              <span className="mbn-item-icon" aria-hidden="true">
                {isHome ? (
                  <span className="mbn-logo-wrap">
                    <svg className="mbn-logo-ring" viewBox="0 0 34 34" aria-hidden="true">
                      <circle cx="17" cy="17" r={RING_R} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeOpacity="0.12" strokeWidth="1.6" />
                      <circle cx="17" cy="17" r={RING_R} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8"
                        strokeLinecap="round" strokeDasharray={RING_C}
                        strokeDashoffset={RING_C * (1 - scrollProgress)}
                        transform="rotate(-90 17 17)" className="mbn-logo-ring-progress" />
                    </svg>
                    <Image src="/logo.png" alt="" width={76} height={76} className="mbn-item-logo" priority={false} />
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <Icon type={item.type} />
                )}
              </span>
              <span className="mbn-item-label">{item.label}</span>
            </Link>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* CTA */}
      <Link
        href={CTA.href}
        className={"mbn-cta" + (isOrderPage ? " is-active" : "")}
        aria-label={CTA.label}
        onClick={() => haptic(CTA.haptic)}
      >
        <span className="mbn-cta-shine" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span className="mbn-cta-pulse" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span className="mbn-item-icon" aria-hidden="true">
          <Icon type={CTA.type} />
        </span>
        <span className="mbn-item-label">{CTA.label}</span>
      </Link>
    </nav>
  );
}

const LIVE_ROTATION_MS = 5500;

const PERSIAN_DIGITS = "۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹";

function toPersian(value: string | number): string {
  return String(value).replace(/\d/g, (d) => PERSIAN_DIGITS[+d]);
}

const CURRENT_PERSIAN_YEAR = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("fa-IR", {
  year: "numeric",
})
  .format(new Date())
  .replace(/[^\u06F0-\u06F9]/g, "")
  .slice(0, 4);

function useTehranClock() {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [time, setTime] = useState("--:--:--");
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    const onVis = () => setVisible(!document.hidden);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVis);

    const update = () => {
      const now = new Date();
      const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
        hour: "2-digit",
        minute: "2-digit",
        second: "2-digit",
        hour12: false,
        timeZone: "Asia/Tehran",
      });
      const parts = fmt.formatToParts(now);
      const get = (t: string) =>
        parts.find((p) => p.type === t)?.value ?? "00";
      setTime(`${get("hour")}:${get("minute")}:${get("second")}`);
    };
    update();

    if (!visible) {
      return () => document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVis);
    }

    const id = window.setInterval(update, 1000);
    return () => {
      window.clearInterval(id);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVis);
    };
  }, [visible]);

  return mounted ? toPersian(time) : "--:--:--";
}

function usePersianDate() {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [date, setDate] = useState({
    day: "--",
    month: "--",
    year: "----",
    weekday: "--",
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    const update = () => {
      const now = new Date();
      const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("fa-IR", {
        day: "numeric",
        month: "long",
        year: "numeric",
        weekday: "long",
        timeZone: "Asia/Tehran",
      });
      const parts = fmt.formatToParts(now);
      const get = (t: string) =>
        parts.find((p) => p.type === t)?.value ?? "--";
      setDate({
        day: get("day"),
        month: get("month"),
        year: get("year").replace(/[^\u06F0-\u06F9]/g, ""),
        weekday: get("weekday"),
      });
    };
    update();
    const id = window.setInterval(update, 30000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(id);
  }, []);

  return mounted
    ? date
    : { day: "--", month: "--", year: "----", weekday: "--" };
}

function useRelativeTime(iso: string | null): string {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [text, setText] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    if (!iso) return;
    const compute = () => {
      const diff = Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime();
      const days = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
      if (days <= 0) setText("امروز");
      else if (days === 1) setText("دیروز");
      else if (days < 30) setText(`${toPersian(days)} روز پیش`);
      else if (days < 365)
        setText(`${toPersian(Math.floor(days / 30))} ماه پیش`);
      else setText(`${toPersian(Math.floor(days / 365))} سال پیش`);
    };
    compute();
    const id = window.setInterval(compute, 120000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(id);
  }, [iso]);

  return mounted ? text : "";
}

  const persianDate = usePersianDate();

              ←
            </span>

export default function Services() {
  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);
  const tabRefs = useRef<Array<HTMLButtonElement | null>>([]);
  const current = services[active];

  const focusTab = (index: number) => {
    setActive(index);
    tabRefs.current[index]?.focus();
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (event: React.KeyboardEvent, index: number) => {
    const last = services.length - 1;
    let nextIndex = index;

    if (event.key === "ArrowDown" || event.key === "ArrowLeft") {
      event.preventDefault();
      nextIndex = index === last ? 0 : index + 1;
    } else if (event.key === "ArrowUp" || event.key === "ArrowRight") {
      event.preventDefault();
      nextIndex = index === 0 ? last : index - 1;
    } else if (event.key === "Home") {
      event.preventDefault();
      nextIndex = 0;
    } else if (event.key === "End") {
      event.preventDefault();
      nextIndex = last;
    } else {
      return;
    }

    focusTab(nextIndex);
  };

  const activeNumber = String(active + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const totalNumber = String(services.length).padStart(2, "0");

  return (
    <section id="services" className="services-section section">
      <div className="container">
        {/* ═══════ MASTHEAD ═══════ */}
        <div className="services-masthead reveal">
          <span className="services-masthead-left">
            CHAPTER&nbsp;·&nbsp;01&nbsp;—&nbsp;SERVICES

export default function Portfolio() {

  const selectedProject =
    selectedIndex !== null ? projects[selectedIndex] : null;

  return (
    <section id="portfolio" className="portfolio-section section">
      <div className="container">
        <div className="section-heading reveal">
          <div>
            <SectionNumber num="۰۳" label="PORTFOLIO" />

          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="portfolio-grid">
          {projects.map((project, index) => (
            <button
              key={project.id}
              type="button"
              className={`portfolio-card portfolio-card-${index + 1} reveal`}
              onClick={() => setSelectedIndex(index)}
              aria-label={`مشاهده پروژه ${project.title} — ${project.category}`}
            >
              <div className="portfolio-card-visual">
                <div className="portfolio-card-chrome">
                  <div
                    className="portfolio-card-chrome-dots"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                  >
                    <span />
                    <span />
                    <span />
                  </div>

                  <div className="portfolio-card-chrome-url">
                    {project.slug}.shorakaei.ir
                  </div>

                  <span className="portfolio-card-chrome-meta">
                    {String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="portfolio-card-canvas">
                  {project.coverImage ? (
                    <Image
                      src={project.coverImage}
                      alt={`نمونه‌کار ${project.title} — ${project.category}`}
                      fill
                      sizes="(max-width: 720px) 100vw, (max-width: 1080px) 55vw, 640px"
                      priority={index === 0}
                      style={{ objectFit: "cover" }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <ProjectPreview id={project.id} />
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="portfolio-card-caption">
                  <div className="portfolio-card-caption-text">
                    <span className="portfolio-card-category">
                      {project.category}
                    </span>
                    <span className="portfolio-card-title">
                      {project.title}
                    </span>
                    <span className="portfolio-card-subtitle">
                      {project.description}
                    </span>
                    <span className="portfolio-card-view" aria-hidden="true">
                      مشاهده پروژه
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <span className="portfolio-card-arrow" aria-hidden="true">
                    ↗
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="portfolio-footer reveal">
          <span>{String(projects.length).padStart(2, "0")} نمونه‌کار</span>
          <span>نمونه‌کارهای بیشتر، به‌زودی</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {selectedProject && selectedIndex !== null && (
        <ProjectViewer
          project={selectedProject}
          index={selectedIndex}
          total={projects.length}
          onPrev={
            selectedIndex > 0
              ? () => setSelectedIndex(selectedIndex - 1)
              : undefined
          }
          onNext={
            selectedIndex < projects.length - 1
              ? () => setSelectedIndex(selectedIndex + 1)
              : undefined
          }
          onClose={() => setSelectedIndex(null)}
        />
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

              <span className="about-proof-label">{point.label}</span>
              <span className="about-proof-hint">{point.hint}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="about-principles reveal">
          <div className="about-principles-heading">
            <span className="eyebrow">اصول کاری</span>
          </div>

          <div className="about-principles-grid">
            {principles.map((principle) => (
              <article key={principle.number} className="about-principle">
                <span className="about-principle-number">
                  {principle.number}

=== FILE: src/components/Newsletter.tsx (4904 bytes)

"use client";

import { FormEvent, useState } from "react";

type Status = "idle" | "loading" | "success" | "error";

export default function Newsletter() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>("idle");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");

  const handleSubmit = async (e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (status === "loading") return;

    setMessage("");

    const trimmed = email.trim();
    if (!trimmed || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(trimmed)) {
      setStatus("error");
      setMessage("ایمیل معتبر وارد کن.");
      return;
    }

    setStatus("loading");

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/newsletter", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: trimmed }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();

      if (!res.ok) {
        setStatus("error");
        setMessage(data.message || "ثبت نشد. یه بار دیگه امتحان کن.");
        return;
      }

      setStatus("success");
      setMessage("");
      setEmail("");
    } catch {
      setStatus("error");
      setMessage("اتصال برقرار نشد. اینترنتت رو چک کن.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <section
      id="newsletter"
      className="newsletter-section section"
      aria-labelledby="newsletter-title"
    >
      <div className="container">
        <div className="newsletter-card reveal">
          <span className="newsletter-eyebrow">
            07 — NEWSLETTER
          </span>

          <h2 id="newsletter-title" className="newsletter-title">
            هفته‌ای یه ایمیل،
            <br />
            <em className="ink-word">بدون اسپم.</em>
          </h2>

          <p className="newsletter-text">
            هر هفته، یه یادداشت کوتاه درباره‌ی طراحی وب، تجربه‌ی
            کاربری و چیزهایی که یاد می‌گیرم. کوتاه، مفید، بدون
            تبلیغ.
          </p>

          {status === "success" ? (
            <div className="newsletter-success" role="status">
              <span className="newsletter-success-icon" aria-hidden="true">
                <svg
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  strokeWidth="2.4"
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                >
                  <polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12" />
                </svg>
              </span>
              <div className="newsletter-success-text">
                <strong>ثبت شد.</strong>
                <span>از هفته‌ی بعد، اولین ایمیل برات میاد.</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <form
              className="newsletter-form"
              onSubmit={handleSubmit}
              noValidate
            >
              <div className="newsletter-input-wrap">
                <input
                  id="newsletter-email"
                  type="email"
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setEmail(e.target.value);
                    if (status === "error") setStatus("idle");
                  }}
                  placeholder="you@example.com"
                  dir="ltr"
                  autoComplete="email"
                  inputMode="email"
                  aria-label="ایمیل"
                  aria-invalid={status === "error"}
                  disabled={status === "loading"}
                />
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                className="newsletter-btn"
                disabled={status === "loading"}
              >
                {status === "loading" ? (
                  <>
                    <span className="newsletter-btn-spinner" aria-hidden="true" />
                    در حال ثبت...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    عضویت
                    <span aria-hidden="true">←</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </form>
          )}

          {status === "error" && message && (
            <p className="newsletter-error" role="alert">
              {message}
            </p>
          )}

          {status !== "success" && (
            <p className="newsletter-hint">
              بدون اسپم. هر وقت خواستی، با یه کلیک لغو کن.
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

"use client";


import SectionNumber from "@/components/SectionNumber";
import { useState } from "react";
import { faqItems } from "@/lib/schema";

export default function FAQ() {
  const [openIndex, setOpenIndex] = useState<number | null>(0);

  const toggle = (index: number) => {
    setOpenIndex(openIndex === index ? null : index);
  };

  return (
    <section className="faq-section section" aria-labelledby="faq-title">
      <div className="container">
        <div className="section-heading reveal">
          <div>
            <SectionNumber num="۰۸" label="FAQ" />
            <h2 id="faq-title">
              سوال‌هایی که
              <em className="ink-word"> زیاد می‌شنوم</em>
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p>
            اگه سؤال دیگه‌ای داری، از طریق صفحه‌ی سفارش یا فرم تماس
            بپرس. توی ۲۴ ساعت جواب می‌دم.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="faq-list reveal">
          {faqItems.map((item, index) => {
            const isOpen = openIndex === index;

            return (
              <div
                key={index}
                className={`faq-item${isOpen ? " is-open" : ""}`}
              >
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="faq-question"
                  onClick={() => toggle(index)}
                  aria-expanded={isOpen}
                >
                  <span
                    className="faq-question-text"
                    data-num={String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
                  >
                    {item.q}
                  </span>
                  <span className="faq-icon" aria-hidden="true">
                    <svg
                      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                      fill="none"
                      stroke="currentColor"
                      strokeWidth="2"
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                    >
                      <path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14" />
                    </svg>
                  </span>
                </button>

                <div
                  className="faq-answer"
                  role="region"
                  aria-hidden={!isOpen}
                >
                  <div className="faq-answer-inner">
                    <p>{item.a}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

                <span className="footer-col-label">{group.label}</span>
                <ul className="footer-col-list">
                  {group.links.map((link) => (
                    <li key={link.label}>
                      <Link href={link.href} className="footer-link">
                        <span>{link.label}</span>
                      </Link>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </nav>
            ))}

            {/* Contact column */}
            <div className="footer-col footer-col--nav footer-col--contact">
              <span className="footer-col-label">CONNECT</span>
              <ContactLinks variant="card" />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Email row */}
          {contactEmail && (
            <div className="footer-email-row">
              <span className="footer-email-label">— EMAIL</span>
              <a
                href={`mailto:${contactEmail}`}
                className="footer-email-value"
                dir="ltr"
              >
                {contactEmail}
              </a>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ═══════ Bottom bar ═══════ */}
      <div className="footer-bottom-wrap">
        <div className="container">
          <div className="footer-bottom">
            <span className="footer-copyright">
              ©&nbsp;{CURRENT_PERSIAN_YEAR}&nbsp;— تمامی حقوق محفوظ است.
            </span>
            <span className="footer-signature-line">
              DESIGN&nbsp;·&nbsp;DEVELOPMENT&nbsp;·&nbsp;AI
            </span>
            <div className="footer-bottom-actions">
              <SoundToggle />
              <a
                href="#home"
                className="footer-back-to-top"
                aria-label="بازگشت به بالای صفحه"
              >
                <span className="footer-back-to-top-label">
                  بازگشت به بالا
                </span>
                <span
                  className="footer-back-to-top-arrow"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                >
                  ↑
                </span>
              </a>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </footer>
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   MOTION SYSTEM — 2026 Global Standards
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   - Physics-based easings (spring, bounce, anticipate)
   - Scroll-driven animations with @supports fallback
   - View Transitions API for route navigation
   - Every layer respects prefers-reduced-motion
   ============================================================ */

:root {
  /* ═══ DURATION SCALE — T-shirt sizing ═══ */
  --motion-instant:   80ms;
  --motion-fast:      160ms;
  --motion-base:      240ms;
  --motion-medium:    320ms;
  --motion-slow:      480ms;
  --motion-slower:    640ms;
  --motion-cinematic: 900ms;

  /* ═══ EASING CURVES ═══ */
  --motion-ease-out:        cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  --motion-ease-in-out:     cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1);
  --motion-ease-emphasis:   cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --motion-ease-spring:     cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
  --motion-ease-bounce:     cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55);
  --motion-ease-anticipate: cubic-bezier(0.36, 0, 0.66, -0.56);
  --motion-ease-sharp:      cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  --motion-ease-cinematic:  cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1);

  /* ═══ COMPOSITE PRESETS ═══ */
  --motion-button: var(--motion-fast) var(--motion-ease-out);
  --motion-card:   var(--motion-medium) var(--motion-ease-emphasis);
  --motion-modal:  var(--motion-medium) var(--motion-ease-emphasis);
  --motion-menu:   var(--motion-base) var(--motion-ease-emphasis);
  --motion-reveal: var(--motion-slow) var(--motion-ease-emphasis);

  /* ═══ DISTANCES ═══ */
  --motion-distance-xs: 4px;
  --motion-distance-sm: 8px;
  --motion-distance-md: 16px;
  --motion-distance-lg: 24px;
  --motion-distance-xl: 40px;

  /* ═══ BLUR VALUES ═══ */
  --motion-blur-sm: blur(2px);
  --motion-blur-md: blur(6px);
  --motion-blur-lg: blur(12px);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION — global safety net
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }

  .motion-slide-up,
  .motion-slide-down,
  .motion-scale-in,
  .motion-bounce-in {
    transform: none !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   UTILITY ANIMATION CLASSES
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.motion-fade {
  animation: motionFadeIn var(--motion-reveal);
}

.motion-slide-up {
  animation: motionSlideUp var(--motion-reveal);
}

.motion-slide-down {
  animation: motionSlideDown var(--motion-reveal);
}

.motion-scale-in {
  animation: motionScaleIn var(--motion-modal);
}

.motion-bounce-in {
  animation: motionBounceIn var(--motion-slow) var(--motion-ease-bounce);
}

.motion-spin {
  animation: motionSpin 1s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes motionFadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to   { opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes motionSlideUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(var(--motion-distance-md));
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes motionSlideDown {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(calc(var(--motion-distance-md) * -1));
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes motionScaleIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.95);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}

@keyframes motionBounceIn {
  0%   { transform: scale(0.7); opacity: 0; }
  60%  { transform: scale(1.08); opacity: 1; }
  100% { transform: scale(1); }
}

@keyframes motionSpin {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to   { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/* ============================================================
   REVEAL SYSTEM — Progressive Enhancement
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   Uses IntersectionObserver as fallback for browsers without
   CSS scroll-driven animation support.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* Legacy reveal (already used in the site) — kept as fallback */
.reveal {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(var(--motion-distance-lg));
  filter: var(--motion-blur-sm);
  transition:
    opacity var(--motion-slower) var(--motion-ease-out),
    transform var(--motion-slower) var(--motion-ease-out),
    filter var(--motion-slower) var(--motion-ease-out);
  will-change: opacity, transform, filter;
}

.reveal.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
  filter: blur(0);
  will-change: auto;
}

/* Staggered reveal delays via inline CSS var */
.reveal {
  transition-delay: var(--reveal-delay, 0ms);
}

/* ── When scroll-driven animations are supported, prefer them ── */
@supports (animation-timeline: view()) {
  .reveal {
    /* Ensure reveal class still works but doesn't fight with
       scroll-driven utilities. Users can opt-in per element. */
  }
}

/* ── Reveal section container (opt-in per block) ── */
.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(1) { --reveal-delay: 0ms; }
.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(2) { --reveal-delay: 60ms; }
.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(3) { --reveal-delay: 120ms; }
.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(4) { --reveal-delay: 180ms; }
.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(5) { --reveal-delay: 240ms; }
.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(6) { --reveal-delay: 300ms; }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .reveal {
    opacity: 1 !important;
    transform: none !important;
    filter: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   MOBILE TYPOGRAPHY — 2026 Global Standards
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   - WCAG 2.2 reading comfort
   - Persian-specific: tall ascenders/descenders need more room
   - 16px minimum body (prevents iOS zoom, meets a11y)
   - 60ch maximum line length on mobile
   - Proper spacing rhythm for paragraphs, lists, quotes
   - Auto-flow for tables and code blocks
   ============================================================ */

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     ROOT SIZE — larger for comfortable reading
     iOS minimum 16px prevents auto-zoom, WCAG AAA recommends 18px
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  html {
    font-size: 17px;
  }

  body {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.8;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     HEADINGS — adjusted scale for mobile
     Larger than desktop ratio to compensate for reduced viewport
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  h1 {
    font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 8vw, 2.25rem);
    line-height: 1.2;
    letter-spacing: -0.015em;
    margin-bottom: 0.6em;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }

  h2 {
    font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 6.5vw, 1.875rem);
    line-height: 1.25;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    margin-bottom: 0.5em;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }

  h3 {
    font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 5.5vw, 1.5rem);
    line-height: 1.35;
    margin-bottom: 0.5em;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }

  h4 {
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
    margin-bottom: 0.5em;
  }

  h5,
  h6 {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     BODY PARAGRAPHS — comfortable reading on small screens
     Line length capped at ~55-60 characters
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  p {

/* ============================================================
   PERFORMANCE OVERRIDE — Non-composited padding fix
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Lighthouse flagged `padding-bottom` and `padding-top` on
   `header.site-nav` and `.nav-inner` as non-composited
   animations. These cause layout thrashing on every scroll
   direction change.

   Fix strategy:
   - Lock `.site-nav` padding to a single value (no change)
   - Remove padding from `.nav-inner` transitions entirely
   - Keep `transform`/`opacity` transitions on `.site-nav`
     so the smart-hide behavior still works (they are composited)
   - Keep `background`/`border`/`box-shadow` on `.nav-inner`
     so the "scrolled" state is still visually clear
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Loaded AFTER layout.css but BEFORE enhancements.css — the
   `!important` flags beat every downstream override.
   ============================================================ */

.site-nav,
.site-nav.is-scrolled {
  padding-block: 14px !important;
  transition:
    transform 380ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1),
    opacity 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
}

.site-nav .nav-inner,
.site-nav.is-scrolled .nav-inner {
  transition:
    background-color var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out),
    border-color var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out) !important;
}
/* ============================================================
   NAV — MagneticButton vertical alignment fix
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   `MagneticButton` wraps children in two inline-block divs
   (.magnetic / .magnetic-inner). Because Persian text has a
   higher visual center inside its em box, the inline baseline
   alignment pushes the button slightly above the nav center.
   Fix: force the wrappers to be inline-flex with centered
   alignment so the pill itself becomes the aligned unit.
   ============================================================ */

.nav-actions .magnetic,
.nav-actions .magnetic-inner {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.nav-actions .magnetic-inner {
  height: 100%;
}

/* ============================================================
   SIGNATURE INK — Hand-drawn underline
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   - Draws like a brush stroke from right to left (RTL-native)
   - Holds for ~1.5s, then fades out
   - Light mode: burnt amber (#B45309) — ink on paper
   - Dark mode:  warm gold   (#E8B27A) — gold on dark ground
   - Variant "--on-dark" for dark / accent buttons
   - Triggered by: hover (desktop) · focus-visible · .is-inking (touch)
   - Respects prefers-reduced-motion
   ============================================================ */

.ink-word {
  --ink-color: #b45309;
  --ink-glow:  rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.38);
  --ink-bleed: rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.18);

  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  isolation: isolate;
  padding-block-end: 0.02em;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .ink-word {
  --ink-color: #e8b27a;
  --ink-glow:  rgba(232, 178, 122, 0.45);
  --ink-bleed: rgba(232, 178, 122, 0.22);
}

/* ─── Variant: on dark / accent backgrounds (buttons) ─── */
.ink-word--on-dark {
  --ink-color: #f5d5a8;
  --ink-glow:  rgba(245, 213, 168, 0.55);
  --ink-bleed: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .ink-word--on-dark {
  --ink-color: #fff3e5;
  --ink-glow:  rgba(255, 243, 229, 0.6);
  --ink-bleed: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
}

/* ─── The brush stroke itself ─── */
.ink-word::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: -0.04em;
  bottom: 0.02em;
  height: 0.115em;
  border-radius: 3px 4px 2px 3px;

  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink-color) 60%, transparent) 0%,
    var(--ink-color) 14%,
    var(--ink-color) 86%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink-color) 60%, transparent) 100%
  );

  box-shadow:
    0 0 10px -1px var(--ink-glow),
    0 0 2px 0 var(--ink-color),
    inset 0 0 4px 0 var(--ink-bleed);

  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: right center;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* ─── Draw → hold → fade ─── */
@keyframes inkDraw {
  0% {
    transform: scaleX(0);
    opacity: 0;
  }
  16% {
    transform: scaleX(1);
    opacity: 1;
  }
  72% {
    transform: scaleX(1);
    opacity: 1;
  }
  100% {
    transform: scaleX(1);
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TRIGGER 1 — Direct hover / keyboard focus on the word
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .ink-word:hover::before,
  .ink-word:focus-visible::before {
    animation: inkDraw 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TRIGGER 2 — Parent CTA hover
   (so hovering button padding draws ink under the label)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .hero-btn:hover .ink-word::before,
  .hero-btn:focus-visible .ink-word::before,
  .button:hover .ink-word::before,
  .button:focus-visible .ink-word::before,
  .button-primary:hover .ink-word::before,
  .button-secondary:hover .ink-word::before,
  .oform-btn:hover .ink-word::before,
  .oform-btn:focus-visible .ink-word::before {
    animation: inkDraw 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
  }
}

/* ─── Touch / any device: class-driven (added by JS on tap) ─── */
.ink-word.is-inking::before {
  animation: inkDraw 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
}

/* ─── Reduced motion: skip the draw, show briefly then fade ─── */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .ink-word::before {
    animation: none !important;
    transition: opacity 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    transform: scaleX(1);
    opacity: 0;
  }

  .ink-word:hover::before,
  .ink-word:focus-visible::before,
  .ink-word.is-inking::before,
  .hero-btn:hover .ink-word::before,
  .button:hover .ink-word::before {
    animation: none !important;
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

/* ─── Buttons: remove overflow clipping so ink glow shows ─── */
.hero-btn .ink-word,
.button .ink-word,
.oform-btn .ink-word {
  overflow: visible;
}

   - Fully percent-encoded data-URI (no raw spaces, no raw #)

   - Minimal targeting: body + 5 solid surfaces
   ============================================================ */

/* ============================================================
   COUNT UP — Visual polish for animated numbers
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Adds subtle visual treatment to numbers that count up:
   - Tabular nums (so digits don't jiggle during animation)
   - Slight letter-spacing during animation
   - Amber glow accent on the animating span
   ============================================================ */

.about-proof-count {
  display: inline-block;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  line-height: 1;
  min-width: 1ch;
  transition: color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.about-proof-count[data-counting="true"] {
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Subtle pulse when counting finishes
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

  0% {
    transform: scale(1.04);
  }
  100% {
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}

.about-proof-count.is-finished {
  animation: proof-count-finish 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);

/* ============================================================
   PERFORMANCE LAYER — Last-Mile Optimization
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   This is NOT a mega-file. It's a surgical override layer
   that touches only what matters for performance, without
   adding new visual rules.

   Strategy:
   1. Content-visibility for below-fold sections
   2. Reduce blur radius (biggest GPU cost)
   3. Reduce box-shadow complexity
   4. Remove unused animations
   5. Clean will-change
   6. Ensure compositor-only animations
   7. Section containment strategy

   Load LAST. No !important unless fighting legacy overrides.
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   1. CONTENT-VISIBILITY — skip rendering off-screen
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.services-section,
.portfolio-section,
.about-section,
.why-section,
.testimonials-section,
.latest-blog-section,
.newsletter-section,
.faq-section,
.final-cta-section,
.commitments-section,
.process-section {
  content-visibility: auto;
  contain-intrinsic-size: auto 900px;
}

.site-footer {
  content-visibility: auto;
  contain-intrinsic-size: auto 700px;
}

/* Hero must stay visible always */
.hero-section {
  content-visibility: visible !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   2. BLUR REDUCTION — the biggest GPU cost on the site
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* Hero orbs — 100px → 80px is barely visible but 40% cheaper */
.hero-section .hero-bg-orb,
.hero-aurora-blob {
  filter: blur(80px);
}

/* Hide the third orb on mobile (has the least visual impact) */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .hero-section .hero-bg-orb-3 {
    display: none;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-bg-orb-2 {
    opacity: 0.35;
  }
}

/* Reduce nav glass blur on mobile (costly on iOS) */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .site-nav.is-scrolled .nav-inner,
  .mobile-nav {
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.3);
  }
}

/* Reduce hero bento cell blur (from 26px → 20px) */
@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .hero-section .hero-bento-cell {
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.5);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.5);
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   3. BOX-SHADOW SIMPLIFICATION
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Complex multi-layer shadows cost paint time.
   Merging into fewer layers keeps the same look.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-bento-cell {
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 12px 32px -16px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.12);
}

.commitment-card,
.process-step,
.latest-blog-card,
.faq-item,
.work-card {
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.04);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   4. PAUSE OFF-SCREEN ANIMATIONS
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Infinite CSS animations consume GPU even when off-screen.
   We pause the costly ones when their section isn't visible.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* Marquee — only animate when Hero is in view */
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-marquee-track {
  animation-play-state: paused;
}

/* Bento Live dot — pause when off screen */
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-bento-live-dot,
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-bento-status-dot {
  animation-play-state: paused;
}

/* Orbs — pause when Hero isn't visible */
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-bg-orb {
  animation-play-state: paused;
}

/* Tab hidden — pause everything */
html[data-tab-hidden="true"] .hero-marquee-track,
html[data-tab-hidden="true"] .hero-bg-orb,
html[data-tab-hidden="true"] .hero-bento-live-dot,
html[data-tab-hidden="true"] .hero-bento-status-dot,
html[data-tab-hidden="true"] .hero-aperture,
html[data-tab-hidden="true"] .chapter-rail-item.is-active .chapter-rail-dot {
  animation-play-state: paused !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   5. WILL-CHANGE CLEANUP
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   will-change should only exist during active animation.
   Leaving it on permanently creates pointless GPU layers.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.reveal,
.reveal-fade,
.reveal-scale,
.hero-bento-cell,
.hero-bento-seal,
.about-brand-mark,
.newsletter-card,
.commitment-card,
.process-step,
.latest-blog-card,
.faq-item {
  will-change: auto;
}

/* Only hint GPU during actual reveal */
.reveal:not(.is-visible) {
  will-change: opacity, transform;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   6. COMPOSITOR-ONLY ANIMATIONS
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Force the few remaining infinite animations to run on the
   compositor thread (transform/opacity only).
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-marquee-track,
.hero-bg-orb,
.hero-bento-live-dot,
.hero-bento-status-dot,
.hero-aperture,
.hero-section .hero-bento-cell-mesh::before,
.chapter-rail-item.is-active .chapter-rail-dot {
  transform: translateZ(0);
  backface-visibility: hidden;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   7. REDUCE HOVER TRANSFORM COST ON MOBILE
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   On touch devices, hover effects never trigger meaningfully.
   Kill them to save GPU cycles.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (hover: none), (pointer: coarse) {
  .portfolio-card:hover .portfolio-card-visual,
  .work-card:hover,
  .latest-blog-card:hover,
  .faq-item:hover,
  .commitment-card:hover,
  .testimonial-card:hover,
  .service-item:hover {
    transform: none;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   8. LAYOUT CONTAINMENT (Desktop only — safe)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */


/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   9. REDUCED MOTION — global safety
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero-marquee-track,
  .hero-bg-orb,
  .hero-bento-live-dot,
  .hero-bento-status-dot,
  .hero-aperture,
  .hero-section .hero-bento-cell-mesh::before,
  .chapter-rail-item.is-active .chapter-rail-dot {
    animation: none !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   10. DATA-SAVER MODE — be kind to metered connections
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-data: reduce) {
  .hero-section .hero-bg-grain,
  .hero-section .hero-bg-grid,
  .manuscript-grid-pattern {
    display: none;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-bg-orb {
    filter: blur(60px);
    opacity: 0.4;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   PERFORMANCE PRO — Desktop Optimization Layer
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Goal: 40-60% reduction in GPU/CPU cost on desktop.
   No visual change. Loaded LAST so it wins all cascade.
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   1. BACKDROP-FILTER REDUCTION — biggest GPU win
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Blur above ~20px is visually indistinguishable but roughly
   doubles GPU cost. We drop to 12-20px across the board.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (min-width: 901px) {
  /* Nav (scrolled) — 40px → 20px */
  .site-nav.is-scrolled .nav-inner {
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.6) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.6) !important;
  }

  /* Hero bento cells — 26px → 16px */
  .hero-section .hero-bento-cell {
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4) !important;
  }

  /* Hero pills/eyebrows — 12px → 10px */
  .hero-section .hero-role,
  .hero-section .hero-top-meta,
  .hero-section .hero-eyebrow {
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.2) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.2) !important;
  }

  /* Service preview — 20px → 12px */
  .service-preview {
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3) !important;
  }

  /* About statement — 20px → 12px */
  .about-statement {
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3) !important;
  }

  /* Final CTA — 16px → 12px */
  .final-cta {
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3) !important;
  }

  /* Order form sections — kill entirely (solid bg) */
  .order-page .form-section,
  .order-form .form-section {
    backdrop-filter: none !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
  }

  /* Modals — 24px → 16px is more than enough */
  .project-modal-shell,
  .project-modal {
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4) !important;
  }

  .welcome-backdrop,
  .welcome-card {
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4) !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   2. KILL BACKDROP-FILTER WHERE IT DOES NOTHING
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   These have solid/near-solid backgrounds — blur has no visible
   effect but still forces an extra compositing pass per frame.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.contact-card,
.commitment-card,
.process-step,
.latest-blog-card,
.faq-item,
.testimonial-card,
.work-card,
.newsletter-card,
.blog-author,
.blog-inline-cta,
.blog-funnel,
.service-item,
.hero-section .hero-bento-seal,
.site-footer .footer-col,
.order-page .form-field input,
.order-page .form-field textarea {
  backdrop-filter: none !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
}

/* Desktop nav list — has solid-ish gradient, blur not needed */
.site-nav .desktop-nav-list {
  backdrop-filter: none !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   3. PAUSE ANIMATIONS WHEN OFF-SCREEN
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   data-perf-pause is set by PerfObserver (JS component).
   Infinite animations burn GPU every frame, even off-screen.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
[data-perf-pause="true"],
[data-perf-pause="true"] *,
[data-perf-pause="true"] *::before,
[data-perf-pause="true"] *::after {
  animation-play-state: paused !important;
}

/* Pause everything when tab is hidden */
html[data-tab-hidden="true"] *,
html[data-tab-hidden="true"] *::before,
html[data-tab-hidden="true"] *::after {
  animation-play-state: paused !important;
}

/* Hero-specific pause (existing pattern, extended) */
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-bg-orb,
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-bg-grid,
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-marquee-track,
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-masthead-dot,
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-bento-status-dot,
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-bento-live-dot,
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-bento-seal,
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-role-dot,
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-eyebrow-dot,
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-sig-path {
  animation-play-state: paused !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   4. WILL-CHANGE CLEANUP
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Permanent will-change hints waste GPU memory (each one
   allocates a full-size texture). Hint only during animation.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.reveal,
.reveal-fade,
.reveal-scale,
.hero-bento-cell,
.commitment-card,
.process-step,
.latest-blog-card,
.faq-item,
.testimonial-card,
.newsletter-card,
.service-preview,
.about-statement {
  will-change: auto;
}

/* Only hint GPU during reveal-in-progress */
.reveal:not(.is-visible) {
  will-change: opacity, transform;
}

/* Composited-layer hints for infinite animations */
.hero-bg-orb,
.hero-marquee-track,
.hero-bento-seal,
.hero-masthead-dot,
.hero-bento-status-dot,
.hero-bento-live-dot,
.hero-section .hero-bento-cell-mesh::before {
  transform: translateZ(0);
  backface-visibility: hidden;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   5. LAYOUT CONTAINMENT — desktop only
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   `contain: layout style` tells the browser style recalc and
   layout are scoped to the subtree. Safe — doesn't affect
   position: fixed/sticky children (that's `contain: paint`).
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */


/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   6. SHADOW SIMPLIFICATION
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Multi-layer shadows cause extra paint passes on every frame
   they change. Simplify to 2-layer where possible.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (min-width: 901px) {
  .commitment-card,
  .process-step,
  .latest-blog-card,
  .faq-item,
  .testimonial-card,
  .newsletter-card,
  .contact-card {
    box-shadow:
      0 1px 2px -1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 5%, transparent),
      0 8px 24px -12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 12%, transparent) !important;
  }

  .commitment-card:hover,
  .process-step:hover,
  .latest-blog-card:hover,
  .faq-item:hover,
  .testimonial-card:hover,
  .contact-card:hover {
    box-shadow:
      0 2px 4px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent),
      0 14px 36px -16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 28%, transparent) !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   7. DISABLE HEAVY HOVER TRANSFORMS ON LOW-END DESKTOP
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Only on touch devices — desktop hover is fine.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (hover: none), (pointer: coarse) {

/* ============================================================
   BLOG EDITORIAL — Infinite Edition
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   سیستم ادیتوریال کامل برای مقالات بلاگ
   
   مبانی طراحی:
   - Perfect Fourth scale (1.333) برای بدنه، Golden Ratio (1.618) برای تیترها[reference:0]
   - Measure: 50-75 کاراکتر (هدف 66)[reference:1]
   - Line-height بدنه: 1.5-1.6 دسکتاپ، 1.3-1.45 موبایل[reference:2]
   - خط‌چین تیترها: 1.1-1.2، تیترهای بزرگ ~1.0 با tracking منفی[reference:3]
   - اندازه فونت بدنه: حداقل 16px، ایده‌آل 18px برای long-form[reference:4]
   - RTL: استفاده از logical properties (start/end) به جای left/right[reference:5]
   - بدون letter-spacing منفی روی فارسی (اتصال حروف را می‌شکند)[reference:6]
   - کاهش انیمیشن در محتوای متنی[reference:7]
   
   ساختار:
   1. Design Tokens (متغیرهای محلی)
   2. Layout & Container
   3. H2 Numbering (شماره‌گذاری خودکار)
   4. H3 & H4
   5. Paragraphs & Lead
   6. Lists
   7. Pull Quote & Blockquote
   8. Code & Pre
   9. Tables
   10. Figure & Caption
   11. Links
   12. HR & Dividers
   13. Editorial Marks
   14. Sidebar Notes
   15. Responsive
   16. Dark Mode
   17. Reduced Motion
   ============================================================ */

  --ed-lh-body:    1.85;

  --ed-measure-narrow: 55ch;
  
  /* ─── Spacing (baseline: 8px) ─── */

  --ed-space-2:  0.5rem;   /* 8px */
  --ed-space-3:  0.75rem;  /* 12px */

/* ============================================================
   FINAL POLISH 2026 — ULTIMATE EDITION
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   基于 WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA、Core Web Vitals 2026、现代 CSS 特性、
   国际化（i18n/RTL）以及性能最佳实践构建。
   
   覆盖范围：
   1. 架构层（@layer）
   2. 零特异性重置（基于 :where()）
   3. 现代色彩系统（oklch, color-mix, relative color）
   4. 无障碍完成度（焦点、目标尺寸、辅助技术）
   5. 用户偏好媒体查询（动效、对比度、透明、数据）
   6. 现代布局（容器查询、:has()、逻辑属性）
   7. 视图过渡与滚动驱动动画
   8. 打印样式
   9. 国际化与双向文本（RTL）
   10. 微细节（选区、光标、滚动条）
   11. 性能优化（GPU 合成、内容可见性）
   12. 终极打磨（排版节奏、间距系统）
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   1. 架构层 — 显式级联顺序
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   使用 @layer 定义明确的优先级，彻底告别 !important 和特异性战争[reference:0]。
   顺序：reset → tokens → base → layout → components → utilities → overrides
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer reset, tokens, base, layout, components, utilities, overrides;

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   2. 零特异性重置 — 基于 :where()
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   所有规则包裹在 :where() 中，特异性为 0，确保任何自定义样式都能轻松覆盖[reference:1]。
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer reset {
  /* 盒模型与尺寸 */
  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0 solid currentColor; /* 确保边框可见于强制颜色模式[reference:2] */
  }

  /* 文档基础 */
  html {
    -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
    -moz-text-size-adjust: 100%;
    text-size-adjust: 100%;
    -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    font-kerning: normal;
    font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures contextual;
    font-synthesis: none;
    scrollbar-gutter: stable; /* 防止滚动条出现/消失时的布局抖动[reference:3] */
    overflow-x: clip; /* 兼容 position: sticky 的水平安全裁剪[reference:4] */
    tab-size: 2;
  }

  /* 正文 */
  body {
    min-height: 100svh;
    line-height: 1.5;
    text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  /* 媒体元素 */
  :where(img, picture, video, canvas, svg) {
    display: block;
    max-inline-size: 100%;
    max-block-size: 100%;
  }

  /* 表单元素 */
  :where(input, button, textarea, select) {
    font: inherit;
    color: inherit;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    outline: none;
    appearance: none;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
  }

  /* 按钮和链接 */
  :where(button, [role="button"]) {
    cursor: pointer;
    background: none;
    text-align: inherit;
  }

  :where(a) {
    color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  /* 列表 */
  :where(ul, ol) {
    list-style: none;
  }

  /* 标题和段落 */
  :where(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, p) {
    font-size: inherit;
    font-weight: inherit;
    text-wrap: balance; /* 标题自动平衡 */
  }

  :where(p) {
    text-wrap: pretty; /* 段落避免孤行 */
  }

  /* 表格 */
  :where(table) {
    border-collapse: collapse;
    border-spacing: 0;
    text-indent: 0;
  }

  /* 代码 */
  :where(pre, code, kbd, samp) {
    font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace);
    font-size: 0.9em;
    direction: ltr; /* 代码始终 LTR */
    unicode-bidi: isolate;
  }

  /* 引用 */
  :where(blockquote, q) {
    quotes: none;
  }

  /* 细节/摘要 */
  :where(details) {
    display: block;
  }

  :where(summary) {
    cursor: pointer;
    list-style: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }

  :where(summary)::-webkit-details-marker {
    display: none;
  }

  :where(summary)::marker {
    content: "";
  }

      border: 1px solid ButtonText;
    }

      forced-color-adjust: auto;
    }
  }
}

    --shadow-lg: 0 12px 32px -12px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.6);
    --shadow-xl: 0 24px 64px -24px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.8);
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   4. 现代色彩函数 — 动态与对比
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   使用相对颜色语法和 color-contrast() 实现自适应对比度[reference:8]。
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer base {
  /* ─── 基于 Accent 的派生色 ─── */
  .derived-accent {
    color: oklch(from var(--accent) l c h); /* 原始 */
    color: oklch(from var(--accent) calc(l + 0.15) c h); /* 变亮 */
    color: oklch(from var(--accent) calc(l - 0.15) c h); /* 变暗 */
    color: oklch(from var(--accent) l calc(c * 0.5) h); /* 去饱和 */
  }

  /* ─── 自适应对比度文本（现代浏览器） ─── */
  @supports (color: contrast-color(red)) {
    .adaptive-text {
      color: contrast-color(var(--surface));
    }
  }

  /* ─── 回退：使用 color-mix 计算亮度差 ─── */
  .adaptive-text-fallback {
    color: light-dark(var(--ink), var(--paper));
  }

  /* ─── 动态透明度（不依赖预定义变量） ─── */
  .tinted {
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 15%, transparent);
    border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 30%, transparent);
  }

  /* ─── 色相旋转动画（使用 @property 实现平滑插值）[reference:9] ─── */
  @property --hue-rotate {
    syntax: "<angle>";
    inherits: false;
    initial-value: 0deg;
  }

  .hue-cycle {
    transition: --hue-rotate 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
  }

  .hue-cycle:hover {
    --hue-rotate: 360deg;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   7. 现代布局 — 容器查询、:has()、逻辑属性
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   组件响应父容器宽度，而非视口[reference:17][reference:18]。
   :has() 实现父级条件样式[reference:19]。
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer layout {
  /* ─── 容器查询基础 ─── */
  .card,
  .work-card,

  }

  @container card (max-width: 400px) {
    :where(.card, .work-card, .blog-card, .commitment-card) {
      padding: var(--space-2);
    }
  }

  /* ─── 卡片在宽容器中 ─── */
  @container card (min-width: 600px) {
    :where(.card, .work-card, .blog-card) {
      padding: var(--space-4);
    }

    :where(.work-card-title, .blog-card-title, .card-title) {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
    }
  }

  /* ─── :has() 条件样式 ─── */
  .form-field:has(input:focus) {
    --field-focus: 1;
  }

  .form-field:has(input:invalid:not(:placeholder-shown)) {
    --field-error: 1;
  }

  .form-field:has(input:valid:not(:placeholder-shown)) {
    --field-valid: 1;
  }

  /* ─── 有图片的卡片 → 溢出隐藏 ─── */
  .work-card:has(img),
  .blog-card:has(img),
  .portfolio-card:has(img) {
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  /* ─── 空列表容器 ─── */
  :where(ul, ol, .grid, .list):not(:has(li, .item, .card))::after {
    content: "هیچ موردی برای نمایش وجود ندارد";
    display: block;
    padding: var(--space-4);
    text-align: center;
    color: var(--ink-3);

  }

  /* ─── 边距使用块轴属性 ─── */

    margin-block-end: var(--space-2);
  }

  :where(p, ul, ol, blockquote, figure, pre, table) {

  }

  /* ─── 内边距使用逻辑属性 ─── */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   8. 视图过渡与滚动驱动动画
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   View Transitions API 和 scroll-driven animations 是现代
   页面过渡和滚动效果的基石[reference:21]。
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer utilities {
  /* ─── 视图过渡（跨页面） ─── */
  @view-transition {
    navigation: auto;
  }

  ::view-transition-old(root) {
    animation: fade-out 200ms var(--ease-out-expo);
  }

  ::view-transition-new(root) {
    animation: fade-in 240ms var(--ease-out-expo);
  }

  @keyframes fade-out {
    from { opacity: 1; }
    to { opacity: 0; }
  }

  @keyframes fade-in {
    from { opacity: 0; }
    to { opacity: 1; }
  }

  /* ─── 滚动驱动动画（渐进增强） ─── */
  @supports (animation-timeline: view()) {
    .scroll-fade-in {
      animation: scroll-fade-in linear both;
      animation-timeline: view();
      animation-range: entry 0% cover 40%;
    }

    .scroll-slide-up {
      animation: scroll-slide-up linear both;
      animation-timeline: view();
      animation-range: entry 0% cover 50%;
    }

    @keyframes scroll-fade-in {
      from { opacity: 0; }
      to { opacity: 1; }
    }

    @keyframes scroll-slide-up {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(24px);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }
  }

  /* ─── 回退：使用 IntersectionObserver（已有 .reveal 系统） ─── */
  @supports not (animation-timeline: view()) {
    .scroll-fade-in,
    .scroll-slide-up {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: none;
    }
  }

  /* ─── 减少动态效果时的回退 ─── */
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    ::view-transition-old(root),
    ::view-transition-new(root) {
      animation: none;
    }

    .scroll-fade-in,
    .scroll-slide-up {
      animation: none !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      transform: none !important;
    }
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   10. 国际化与双向文本（RTL 最佳实践）
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   波斯语文本永远不应应用 letter-spacing[reference:22]。
   代码和 LTR 内容使用 bidi isolate[reference:23]。
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer base {
  /* ─── 波斯语文本：无 letter-spacing ─── */
  :where([lang="fa"], [lang="ar"], [lang="ur"], [dir="rtl"]) {
    letter-spacing: 0;
    word-spacing: normal;
  }

  /* ─── 拉丁语文本：可以使用 letter-spacing ─── */
  :where([lang="en"], [lang="la"]) {
    letter-spacing: normal;
  }

  /* ─── 混合方向内容 ─── */
  .ltr-content {
    direction: ltr;
    unicode-bidi: isolate;
  }

  .rtl-content {
    direction: rtl;
    unicode-bidi: isolate;
  }

  /* ─── 数字：波斯语数字使用 tabular-nums ─── */
  .persian-nums {
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    direction: ltr;
    unicode-bidi: isolate;
    font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1;
  }

  /* ─── 拉丁数字 ─── */
  .latin-nums {
    direction: ltr;
    unicode-bidi: isolate;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums;
  }

  /* ─── 代码块始终 LTR ─── */
  :where(pre, code, kbd, samp) {
    direction: ltr !important;
    unicode-bidi: isolate !important;
    text-align: left !important;
  }

  /* ─── 表单输入：根据内容方向自动切换 ─── */
  :where(input[type="email"], input[type="url"], input[type="tel"], input[type="number"]) {
    direction: ltr;
    text-align: start;
  }

  /* ─── 双向文本的容器 ─── */
  .bidi-container {
    unicode-bidi: plaintext;
  }

  /* ─── 波斯语 Typography 优化 ─── */
  :where([lang="fa"]) :where(p, li, dd, blockquote) {
    line-height: 1.85; /* 波斯语需要更高的行高 */
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }
}
